name: Tierno
source:
Tierno is one of Red's potential roommates. He is musically inclined and already set his sights on perfecting a Pokémon dance crew, even before enrolling at Kobukan Academy. His best friend is Trevor, and the two of them can usually be seen hanging out together. He has a not-so-subtle infatuation with Serena, yet he never shows any signs to follow through, possibly due to his preference to avoid drama and conflicts in general.

Tierno was first introduced in Pokémon X and Pokémon Y versions.
